pages.text: The wagon moves forward or backward, without strafing. Hold forward to accelerate; release it to coast to a stop. Backward brakes first, then reverses if held.$(br2)Left and right steer. Only the driver controls it: the single seat, the left position of a two-seat bench, or the middle of a three-seat bench.

While moving forward, tap $(k:sprint) to raise the speed limit. The boost lasts until forward is released; it does not apply in reverse.$(br2)Standard boxes are fastest; wide boxes are slowest. Occupied cargo slots reduce boost and acceleration. A mat occupies three slots; a stool occupies one. Items inside containers add no extra slots.

The server configuration controls speeds and cargo penalties, so this handbook does not prescribe fixed values. Loading or unloading while driving updates the limit.$(br2)If controls fail, check the driver’s position, entity assembly and every required hitch.
